name: REVENGE
detailed_description:
GET YOUR REVENGE!

REVENGE is a new multiplayer co-op PvE shooter game that is built around connecting players on many different levels. By integrating cooperative gameplay with interactive spectator participation, we’re expanding the definition of what a multiplayer game can be:

PLAY. GUIDE. SPECTATE … AND GET YOUR REVENGE.

Play in 3 ways:

As a Raider (the core FPS experience):

Raiders are the boots on the ground— a four-player FPS squad navigating the surreal landscapes of The Everreach. Your mission? Survive, collect valuable data, and get out before it’s too late.

As a Guide (The Tactical Overseers)

Guides serve as strategic support for the Raiders whilst also acting as the crucial link to Oracles. Played by four additional players in-game, Guides enhance coordination & support, ensuring that no Raider is left behind.

As an Oracle (The Interactive Spectators)

Oracles are Twitch viewers & spectators, but not in a passive sense. Through an innovative new Twitch-stream integration and in-game commands we call CROWD-PLAY GAMING, Oracles directly can influence the match in real-time. Anyone watching a live match can engage with the game, expanding the player base beyond those in the match itself.

THE STORY

After the apocalypse, humanity clings to survival in The Everreach—a virtual utopia housing the last remnants of the old world’s knowledge. But this haven has been infected by MARA, a sinister sentient computer virus. Though she’s been quarantined, it’s not long before she breaks free and consumes what’s left of humanity’s future.

As a Raider, your mission is clear: Alongside your team, venture into MARA's domain, confront her horrors, recover vital resources, and uncover the truth behind her origins. Fail, and MARA will escape, dooming humanity.

But you won’t face this alone. Guides support in-game whilst Oracles, watching from afar, can influence the battlefield in real-time. Whether they offer aid or chaos, their decisions impact each encounter, meaning the difference between survival and extinction.

The Everreach is an evolving world, shaped by your victories and defeats. Only through unity and strategy can you hope to keep MARA at bay and save the future.
